# AlphaCom Online

> Technology shop at No 3 Adepele Street, off Medical Road, Computer Village, Ikeja, Lagos. Genuine electronics, warranty, and delivery across Nigeria.

AlphaCom sells computer accessories in store and online, including cables, chargers, earbuds, printers, laptop bags, power banks, and brands such as Anker, Logitech, Micropack, and SanDisk.
